# PDF.js 6.3.289 — runtime for the embedded floor template

Unmodified distribution files from Mozilla PDF.js / pdfjs-dist 6.3.289:
https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js
https://www.npmjs.com/package/pdfjs-dist/v/6.3.289

Retrieved from https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/pdfjs-dist@6.3.289/ .
The subset contains the viewer, PDF parser/worker, sandbox, QuickJS WebAssembly runtime and fonts used by the approved floor template. Original licenses are included. Other document readers continue using their existing configuration.
